title: WANLI: Worker and AI Collaboration for Natural Language Inference Dataset Creation

bias_targets.methodology: Using Named Entity Recognition (NER) to extract location mentions from the dataset and mapping them to specific countries using geopy to evaluate the over-representation of Western entities (Europe and North America).

Training partial-input (hypothesis-only and premise-only) classifiers to predict labels without full context, and plotting statistical correlations between individual words and specific class labels to identify dataset artifacts.
